ACOUSTIC COMPLETION, COMPLETE CAPACITY DUALITY AND FINITE SUPPORT
31 October 2026. Mathematical proof with exact algebraic operations.

RESULTS

Keep the acquired non-aligned quartic F=F_* and its entire twelve-
dimensional admitted cubic space V. All previous proofs, constructions
and scoped failures remain unchanged.

1. The eight cubic modes beyond argument translation are EXACTLY two
   binary cubic acoustic-jet charges. The charge map has rank eight
   and its kernel is precisely the four translations DF:V0. Every
   nontranslation cubic has a strictly positive limiting-cost defect
   at some singular acoustic direction.

2. Completing the capacity kernel by those acoustic limits gives an
   exact all-allocation duality. For ANY ACTUAL periodic gradient G
   with positive definite covariance, the least variational energy
   over ALL globally ROC polynomials with leading F equals

       <F(G)> - min_mu (1/2) ell^T W_bar(mu)^+ ell.         (A)

   Here mu ranges over ALL positive rank-one covariance allocations,
   with the continuous completed acoustic kernel. Both optima are
   attained. Thus failure for every completed allocation is equivalent
   to a genuine negative energy for some globally ROC polynomial on
   this actual field. A failed fixed catalogue does not establish this.

3. An optimal completed allocation needs AT MOST SIXTEEN rank-one
   directions. The directions depend on the field. Some can be acoustic
   LIMIT atoms, rather than finite-background Hessian evaluations.
   If the entire eight-dimensional correlation vector is zero, four
   ordinary rank-one directions suffice.

4. Every supplied finite canonical catalogue can be compressed exactly
   to at most seventeen atoms without changing covariance, ANY of the
   twelve cubic targets, or its canonical cost. This algebraic operation
   does not require global optimization. An actual twelve-mode full-
   covariance field is compressed from 21 to 17 ORDINARY atoms exactly.

5. The full-covariance hypothesis loses no possible QC separation.
   Four arbitrarily small actual Fourier modes make covariance positive
   definite while preserving any strict negative compatible energy.
   The executable operation preserves the sign by an exact polynomial
   bound and does NOT admit its input polynomial as globally ROC.

These results are a foundational characterization, not a solution of
